results.title: Man accused of stabbing Albuquerque resident, claimed to be 'Michael the Archangel'
results.description: Collin Terrazas, 43, is charged with murder and tampering with evidence in the stabbing death of Dante Conley in Northeast Albuquerque. Terrazas was tased and arrested Sunday at Journal Center after telling a smoke shop employee he had slit a man's throat.

results.title: Kyle’s $99 show falls apart within minutes
results.description: Kyle Sandilands’ subscription radio show Kyle Sandilands Live got off to a shambolic start on Monday morning, plagued by tech issues – and with one member of Sandilands’ team dropping the C-bomb six minutes into the show.
